The right pane. Resolves the node's adapter for body / tabs / header actions, falling back to the built-in default body. Shows an empty state when nothing is selected.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/test-runner/TestDetailPanel.tsx)
